title: feat(scenarios): skill-evals runs the published skills' eval cases on a with-skill and a no-skill arm
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg1NmbJpZhtiWQkTir
Part of #34764 — this PR is the runner. The eval lane's charter line is the seat's own PR, after this one lands.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`@objectstack/scenarios` 里新增 `skill-evals` 运行器,只从仓库检出运行,不进发布的 bin 或 exports。它用订阅登录的 Claude Code 把已发布技能现成的 209 个评测用例逐条发给模型,每条跑两次,一次装上技能、一次不装,再按用例自带的 must_contain / must_not_contain 机械打分,写出每次的 JSON 记录和汇总。
- **为什么改**:#34691 S2 裁定 A:技能评测每周跑一轮,带一个不装技能的对照臂。在此之前,这些用例从没被送进过模型。
- **风险与回滚**:不进 CI,不拦合并。dist 里查不到该运行器的符号(已实测)。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。唯一的外部影响是一轮会用掉订阅额度:本轮让七日用量从 0.45 涨到 0.56,用量到 0.9 时运行器自己停下。
- **先看**:① `src/skill-evals/run.ts` 的 `verdictOf`,判断两臂是否装对、怎么打分;② `src/skill-evals/arms.ts`,两臂的 argv 和临时目录(技能的 `evals/` 不拷进去);③ `src/skill-evals/cli.ts`,登录守卫排在读取任何东西之前,以及 `--regrade`:修复轮 2 起,每条记录带用例哈希,用例改过的不重新打分、单列在通过率之外(`run.ts` 的 `regradeRecords`)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --dry-run`。预期输出 11 个 bundle 和 `209 case(s) × 2 arms × 1 repeat(s) = 418 turn(s)`,外加一行 argv,不调用模型。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/`** (new, unpublished). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals` adds one `scripts` entry. The tsup entries, `bin` and `exports` are unchanged.
  - `cases.ts` reads `skills/BUNDLE/evals/*.json` strictly. A case that does not parse, uses the wrong types or asserts nothing is a located refusal, never a pass. It also reads which bundles set `user-invocable: false`.
  - `grade.ts`: pass = every `must_contain` present and no `must_not_contain`, as literal case-sensitive substrings of the answer (the result line's text).
  - `arms.ts`: one fresh temp dir per turn. The with-skill arm gets `.claude/skills/BUNDLE/` copied **without `evals/`**, and the no-skill arm gets nothing. Both arms run `--setting-sources project --tools Read,Glob,Grep,Skill --allowedTools Skill`, an empty `--mcp-config` with `--strict-mcp-config`, and `--no-session-persistence`.
  - `run.ts`: the preflight **imports** `subscriptionOnlyEnv` / `assertSubscriptionLogin` / `effortLevelsFromHelp` from `runner/driver.ts`, `runTurnProcess` and `parseStreamJson` (none copied). It also judges each turn: `pass` / `fail` / `invalid` (wrong arm) / `error` (no answer). The round stops on the rate-limit window (`--max-utilization`, default 0.9, exit 3).
  - `summary.ts`: per bundle, each arm's pass rate, the with-skill failures and the cases where no-skill ≥ with-skill. Per case, both arms. Written as `round.json`, `summary.md` and `summary.github.md` (angle brackets spelled out for a GitHub body).
  - `self-test.ts`: 21 table rows with a pinned roster, a floor and a verdict handshake, per AGENTS.md "Writing a `--self-test`".
  - `cli.ts`: `--skills a,b`, `--skills-from workspace|VERSION` (packs `@objectstack/skills@VERSION` from npm), `--repeats`, `--concurrency`, `--max-turns`, `--case-timeout`, `--max-utilization`, `--model`, `--effort`, `--bin`, `--out` (default under the git-ignored `docs/qa/platform-checklist/runs/`), `--dry-run`, `--regrade DIR`, `--self-test`.
- `runner/driver.ts` and `runner/cli.ts` are not edited.
- README section "Running the published skills' eval cases": login, arms, grading, records, quota, and cost and time from this PR's round.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/scenarios` patch. The README is in `files[]`, so its text ships. Nothing else a consumer installs changes.

## Tests

- `test/skill-evals/skill-evals.test.ts`, 26 tests. No model and no network; a turn is an injected function or a stand-in `claude` script.
  - A round refuses to start with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` set: from the preflight, and from the command line, where the stand-in is never asked a turn and no `--out` is created. `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, an `api_key` login and no login are refused too.
  - The grader passes and fails, and a case-only difference is a fail.
  - `--self-test` passes with the real grader. It reds and never reaches its verdict when given a broken grader that passes everything, or an empty catalog.
  - The arms' argv. Each turn sees its arm's directory (bundle without `evals/`, or empty), the prompt on stdin, and no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` in its environment. Its directory is removed afterwards.
  - The rate-limit stop, the summary arithmetic, the `user-invocable: false` handling, and `--regrade`.

<details><summary>Readings at head 9de1cbdc</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, under `os-verify-lock`: `Test Files 36 passed (36)`, `Tests 1013 passed (1013)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --self-test`: `✓ skill-evals self-test: 20 rows pass.`
- `skill-evals --dry-run`: 11 bundles, `209 case(s) × 2 arms × 1 repeat(s) = 418 turn(s)`.
- Ablation (committed fix first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). The live preflight call in `cli.ts` was replaced with a constant login. Anchor x1 → x0, blob `8017e60d` → `e1b6bbe8`. The CLI refusal test went red (`1 failed | 18 passed (19)`). Restored to blob `8017e60d` = HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live round** on this container's subscription login. 209 cases × 2 arms × 1 rep = 418 turns, `--concurrency 4`, 56.1 min, all 418 ran, served `claude-opus-5-5` on every turn. Notional cost 71.24 USD; seven-day utilization 0.45 → 0.56. Result: with-skill 144/209 (69%), no-skill 20/209 (10%). 65 cases fail on the with-skill arm. The full per-bundle and per-case scores are in the `eval-run` record linked from #34764.
- **Measured during the round, and fixed here.** `objectui` sets `user-invocable: false`. Claude Code 2.1.326 leaves such a skill out of the init line's `skills` list, but the model can still launch it. The first arm check therefore read all 34 `objectui` with-skill turns as `invalid`, although 33 of them launched `objectui`. The check now grades them and records `armEvidence` (`launched` / `not-shown`). `--regrade` re-drew those 34 verdicts from the recorded answers, asking no model. The turns ran at `adf4081a`, and `arms.ts`, `grade.ts` and the turn-running lines are byte-identical at head.
- `no-skill ≥ with-skill` counts cases where both arms fail as well. This round: 2 cases where no-skill > with-skill, 18 where both pass, 63 where both fail.
- 144 permission denials across 111 turns, a tool call refused for a missing permission (such as a read outside the turn's directory). This round's records keep only the count. The runner now also records the refused tool's name.
- Measured, and reflected in the arms: a user skill under `~/.claude/skills/` is absent from a turn's init line under `--setting-sources project`. A read outside the turn's directory is refused in `-p` (`requested permissions to read … but you haven't granted it yet`). The published `@objectstack/skills@18.5.0` ships `dist/skills/BUNDLE/evals/` (29 tarball entries match `evals/`), so `--skills-from VERSION` reads that version's cases too.

## Verification

- Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 75 commands at head) were all run locally. `dispatch-gates --ran`: `75 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. The one is `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its fixture needs an unshallowed clone; it is a checker self-test and does not read this diff).
- Publish surface: after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`, `gradeAnswer` is in 0 files under `dist/` (control: `assertSubscriptionLogin` is in 8).
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before each push: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (origin/main, #34808, #33849).
- CI check-runs: in progress when this was opened.

## Fix round 2 (L1 S1, note N1)

- **S1: `--regrade` grades an old answer only against the case that ran.**
  - Every run record now carries `caseHash`: a sha256 of the case's prompt and both token lists, as the turn ran them. `expected_output` is left out because it is neither sent nor graded.
  - On `--regrade`, each record's hash is compared with the case now (`caseDrift`: `same` / `changed` / `unhashed`). `regradeRecords` in `run.ts` then sorts the cases:
    - A case **changed** since the round, or **removed** from the catalog, is set apart. It is not regraded and its record files are left byte-for-byte as they are. It is left out of the summary's pass rates, and the summary header names it: `M case(s) changed since the round, set apart: not regraded and out of every pass rate below: KEYS`. `regradeRecord` itself also refuses a changed case.
    - A case **added** since the round is left out. Before this, it was counted as not run.
    - A record with **no hash** (one written before this round, such as the 2026-11-17 round) is regraded against the case as it is now. It is counted as `unhashed`, and the header says nothing shows those cases are the ones that ran.
  - `round.json` `regraded` gains `unhashed`, `setApart: { changed, removed }` and `added`. The planned set survives a second regrade.
  - **Why set apart rather than refuse.** Refusing the whole regrade would make every round recorded before a reword impossible to regrade, and #34789 rewords cases across the catalog. Regrading the changed case would mix week-N answers with week-N+1 assertions. Setting it apart keeps the rule regrade for the unchanged cases and keeps the changed ones visible outside the rates.
- **N1.** The census prose in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` was re-measured at `e2c2b8c2` with `compoundAnchorDecls` over `git ls-files` (bare declarations counted by renaming `selfTest` to a probe name the anchor still matches): 330 matches, 294 bare, 36 compound over 29 spellings, 21 under `ui/`. The compound half matches the table (36 rows). The prose is comment-only.
- README: one paragraph on `caseHash` and the set-apart rule, under Grading. The changeset is unchanged, since its sentence still describes the README.

<details><summary>Readings at head bd40928d</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` and `vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/skill-evals/skill-evals.test.ts`, under `os-verify-lock`: `Tests 26 passed (26)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The whole package after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`: `Test Files 36 passed (36)`, `Tests 1017 passed (1017)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `skill-evals --self-test`: `✓ skill-evals self-test: 21 rows pass.` The new row is `regrade: a case changed since the round → SET APART, never graded against the new text`.
- New pins: every record carries its case hash (and `expected_output` does not move it). An unchanged case regrades normally, a changed one is set apart and refused by `regradeRecord`, and an unhashed record is regraded and counted. A removed case is set apart and an added one is left out. The command runs on a fixture round: the reworded case's record bytes are unchanged, the summary names it, and it is out of the totals.
- Ablation (fix committed first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). `caseDrift`'s comparison `return rec.caseHash === hashCase(c) ? 'same' : 'changed';` was replaced with `return 'same';`. Anchor x1 → x0, blob `b48c9627` → `10e64fff`. The result was `Tests 4 failed | 22 passed (26)`: both regrade pins, the self-test row, and the empty-catalog self-test count. Restored to blob `b48c9627` = HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `--regrade` on a scratch copy of the 2026-11-17 regraded round, with no model asked: `418 record(s) carry no case hash … regraded against the cases as they are now`. The setApart and added lists are empty, and the summary is identical to the recorded one (with-skill 144/209, no-skill 20/209).
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (because the ledger file was touched): `EXIT=0`, `✓ every compound self-test NAME the anchor matches is classified in COMPOUND_ANCHOR_LEDGER`, and the fast tier `2217 cases pass`. The slow tier is deferred to CI.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: OK. `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (origin/main, #34882, #33849).
- Local scope was narrowed to the dispatch's list. The derived `--commands` set (121 over the whole PR change set) is left to CI.

</details>
